summary: Design bank-wide AI governance, analytics portfolios, and model controls. Build practical executive deliverables in this advanced course.
lede: AI and advanced analytics operating models for banks provide a structured way to move from isolated pilots to controlled, bank-wide deployment. This course connects portfolio prioritisation, data ownership, model validation, human oversight, third-party controls, and outcome monitoring across credit, anti-money laundering, collections, risk, compliance, technology, and business teams. You will practise building an AI use-case portfolio, scoring investment choices, mapping governance responsibilities, classifying model risk, setting monitoring thresholds, and preparing executive and supervisory reports. Hands-on exercises use credit, AML, collections, data ownership, model inventory, and dashboard materials to turn policy, analytics capability, and business demand into a coordinated management system.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior banking, risk, analytics, compliance, and supervisory professionals who must connect AI investment with accountable financial-services governance.
modules: AML Analytics and Financial Crime Controls
Model Risk and Fintech Partnership Governance
prerequisites: You should hold a senior responsibility in banking, risk, compliance, data, analytics, supervision, or financial-services transformation. Prior exposure to credit risk, AML controls, model governance, data governance, or banking operations will help you contribute effectively. No programming is required. The course addresses advanced AI governance and analytics concepts at operational application level, with selected technical topics introduced at conceptual awareness level. You should bring a current or representative banking use case, subject to confidentiality requirements.
